fuente.titulo: Pope at Angelus: Without forgiveness we cannot live in peace

titular: Pope Leo XIV: forgiveness is key to peace
bajada: At Sunday Angelus, Pope reflects on forgiving others to counter hatred and division
caption: At today's Angelus, Pope Leo XIV spoke on the power of forgiveness, saying that following Christ's example of forgiving others can help counter hatred, division and violence, and promote peace and love. Source: Vatican News, Sept 13, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: St. Peter's Square viewed from a distance, the Pope appears small on the balcony in the upper right third, waving to the crowd below, left and center of the frame open and calm.
